headline: Get Budclaw
title: How to Get Budclaw | The Pond Trick | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Budclaw is number twenty three in the Aniimo list, a Break Aniimo with the Stealth trait. The fastest spot is the pond below the Bloom node north of Beast Fang Ridge. Teleport there, glide down the cliff, and look in the shallow water by the lilies. It also lives in Nimbus Fields and more. At level twenty one it evolves into Shrubclaw or Geoclaw. Which would you pick? Comment below!
description: Aniimo's Budclaw can be found fastest at the pond below the Bloom node north of Beast Fang Ridge, and also in Nimbus Fields and other areas. At level 21 it evolves into Shrubclaw or Geoclaw.
